description: The finished deck or document by link: PDF, editable PowerPoint (pptx) or post images.

artboards.description: Pages in the order wanted (index, id or name). Default: every page artboard in order.

file_name.description: The file's name, e.g. "LittleNest seed deck".

format.description: "pdf" (default): every font embedded, every page as designed. "pptx": editable PowerPoint (text boxes over the design, speaker notes). "images": every page as a PNG plus its SVG, one zip, for posts (X cards, carousels).

name: export_document
title: Export the deck or document
